home.cardSubtitle: Describe your business — Voyager drafts the organization, you approve it
home.orgFixtureHint: Demo organization — will reflect your real PSX organization once connected

founder.title: Create your company
founder.subtitle: Talk with Voyager — it will build the organization with you
founder.loginRequired: Connect your PSX account first (panel above) — the organization is created in the runtime under your identity.
founder.bootstrapRepeat: (recovered by idempotency key — same request, same organization)
founder.appliedReal: Organization created in the PSX runtime: {{nome}}. Canonical chain confirmed by read-back — org {{nome}}, primary company {{azienda}}, main site {{sede}}, SHARED runtime {{runtime}} (isolation {{isolation}}).{{repeat}} Departments shown remain a demo until the Department & Employee contract is delivered.
founder.omonima: An organization named “{{nome}}” already exists. Pick a different name. Existing: {{lista}}
founder.provisioned: Departments and employees created in the runtime: {{reparti}} departments, {{dipendenti}} AI employees.
founder.provisionErrors: {{count}} items could not be created — retry is safe (idempotent).
founder.intro: Hi! I am Voyager, your company builder. Tell me about your business and I will draft the organization for you: departments, people and their specialties. Shall we start?
founder.askName: First: what is the name of your company?
founder.askSector: Great name! What sector does it operate in? (e.g. construction, marketing agency, retail…)
founder.askHq: Where is it based? (city or headquarters)
founder.askWebsite: And the website address? (if you have one)
founder.applying: Creating the organization in the PSX runtime…
founder.connectSubtitle: Sign in with your PSX account — Voyager reads your organization live (read-only)

account.title: Account
account.signInSubtitle: Use your PSX Workbench account — your organization loads automatically next time (encrypted session)
account.noPasswordStored: Passwords are never stored — only an encrypted, revocable session.
account.loginFailed: Sign in failed. Check your credentials.
account.noOrgs: No organization for this account yet.
account.authorityNote: Identity, organization, membership and roles are canonical PSX data — shown as-is, never duplicated.

team.title: Team
team.signInRequired: Sign in from the Account page to see your team.
team.noOrgSelected: No organization selected. Choose one on the Account page.
team.noEmployees: No AI employees yet — they are created through the canonical provisioning flow.
team.humanNotAvailable: Not available yet: the Runtime payload does not expose human membership — it will appear here via the canonical contract, without duplicates.
team.inviteDisabled: Invite is disabled until PSX delivers the canonical invitation contract.
team.inviteReadyNote: Invite human collaborators to this organization (org-scoped, PSX canonical).
team.inviteCreated: Invite created — send the join link to your collaborator.
team.agentApproveNote: Review the proposal. On approval the AI Employee is created directly in the PSX Agent Registry (never locally only).
team.agentBridgeNote: The execution mapping is registered as SYNC_PENDING; it becomes SYNCED after the aioncore engine is linked and confirmed with a canonical read-back.
team.agentCreatedNote: {{name}} now exists in the PSX Agent Registry.
team.agentSyncNote: Execution mapping — PSX is the single source of truth.
team.editPartialNote: Partial update: only the fields you actually change are sent (idempotent by design).
team.editSaved: AI Employee updated in the PSX Agent Registry
team.retireNote: The employee is disabled in the PSX Agent Registry. The execution mapping will show SYNC_FAILED until reactivation.
team.dispatchPh: Describe the task for this AI employee…
team.dispatchNote: The task is queued in the PSX order queue (single path rule). The employee picks it up per its configuration.
team.dispatchAccepted: Task accepted by the PSX queue.
team.dispatchOrderNote: The employee picks it up per its configuration. Status updates automatically.
team.inviteModalNote: The invite is created in the PSX runtime for this organization. The collaborator opens the join link and accepts with their account.

join.title: Join a VOYAGER organization
join.missingToken: No invite token in this link.
join.notFound: Invite not found — it may have expired or been revoked.
join.accepted: Invite accepted — the organization is now in your account.

sessions.lockedSubtitle: Sign in with your account to see your conversations — they stay stored and reappear after login.
